title: Advanced Raku Workshop - Genie Sue Weppner
cost_text: $155 workshop fee, $10 firing fee charged during workshop
commitment: One full weekend (October 17-18) 9:30 AM to 4:00 PM and 4 weekday evenings (Tuesday October 20 through Friday October 23) from 3:30 PM to 6:30 PM and all day Saturday October 24 starting at 9:00 AM
how_to_join: Register through registration form at workshop page
summary: A raku firing workshop for potters with prior raku experience or who have attended one of Genie Sue Weppner's previous raku workshops. Participants make, glaze, and fire pieces, leaving with 2-5 finished pieces.
